info.title: API.SH: Justia
info.description: The Justia API from API.SH: public Justia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Browse case law on Justia (law.justia.com/cases): the courts of a state or the federal system, a court's years and volumes (`links`), and a year's or volume's decisions (`cases`: `name`, `url`, `date`, `docket_number`, `citation`). `total` is the number of decisions in the list. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justia-cases

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A law.justia.com/cases/... path or link, e.g. `/cases/` (all courts), `/cases/california/`, `/cases/federal/9th-cir/2025/`. Default `/cases/`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: 2025 Ninth Circuit U.S. Court of Appeals Case Law

get.description:
Search U.S. law on Justia (law.justia.com): case law, codes, regulations and the Constitution. Each result: `title`, `url`, `snippet`, `description`, `type` (`cases`, `codes`, `regulations`, `constitution`) and `raw`. `section` or `path` narrows the search (e.g. one court). 10 a page, up to 10 pages; `total_estimate` is the site's estimate. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justia-law-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to search, e.g. `miranda rights`.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Limit to `cases`, `codes`, `regulations` or `constitution`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Limit to a law.justia.com path, e.g. `/cases/california/supreme-court/`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default) or `date`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Lawyers in the Justia lawyer directory (justia.com/lawyers) for a practice area and place, with every filter of the listing page: free consultation, top rated, open now, video conferencing, credit cards, years of experience, language, service and what the profile includes. Each lawyer: `id`, `name`, `url`, `sponsored`, `listing_tier`, `headline`, `years_experience`, `phone`, `address`, `practice_areas`, `law_schools`, `tagline`, `description`, `website`, `badges` and `photo` (practice contact details only). `available_filters` lists the language and service values of this page. Sponsored listings come first and may repeat on later pages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justia-lawyers

parameters.name: practice_area
parameters.description: Practice area slug as on Justia, e.g. `divorce`, `criminal-law`, `personal-injury` (see `/justia/v1/practice-areas`).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state: two-letter code (`WA`) or name (`washington`).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City, e.g. `Seattle` (needs a state).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of practice_area, state and city: a justia.com/lawyers/<practice-area>/<state>/<city> directory link.

parameters.name: free_consultation
parameters.description: `true`: only lawyers who offer a free consultation.

parameters.name: top_rated
parameters.description: `true`: only top-rated lawyers (Justia Lawyer Rating 9+).

parameters.name: open_now
parameters.description: `true`: only offices open now.

parameters.name: video_chat
parameters.description: `true`: only lawyers who offer video conferencing.

parameters.name: accepts_credit_cards
parameters.description: `true`: only lawyers who accept credit cards.

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Minimum years of experience: `5`, `10` or `20`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language spoken, by name (e.g. `Spanish`) or the id in `available_filters.language`.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: A service within the practice area, by name (e.g. `Uncontested Divorce`) or the id in `available_filters.service`.

parameters.name: profile_includes
parameters.description: Comma-separated profile contents the lawyer must have: `photo`, `awards`, `certifications`, `claimed`, `professional_associations`, `publications`, `videos`, `website`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-200). Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every practice area of the Justia lawyer directory (`slug`, `name`, `url`) and the state slugs, for use with `/justia/v1/lawyers`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justia-practice-areas

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
